title: SEC0: fallback to 127.0.0.1 on parse failure silently whitelists
description: session.rs:171-174: if peer_addr fails SocketAddr::parse, client_ip defaults to 127.0.0.1. If 127.0.0.0/8 is in peer_whitelist, any connection whose peer_addr string fails to parse gets incorrectly whitelisted. In current deployment peer_addr comes from the OS so this cannot happen in practice. But the fallback is semantically wrong: unparseable address should not grant loopback identity. Safer default: 0.0.0.0 (unroutable sentinel). Same issue in config.rs whitelist_check() helper line 796.
